answer: Require every agent to lock a stake in a shared grove of escrowed deposits before it can attest work: the deposit is slashed on proven fraud, so creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand forfeitable bonds. At its nadir, the scheme still holds because a Sybil attacker's cost scales linearly with each identity while honest reputation compounds over time. The velvet glove is that small honest agents pay almost nothing - only proven cheaters feel the teeth - which keeps entry open without letting sockpuppets vote themselves rich.
